On this comet, every kid wears one. Even at recess.
Grandpa walks his grandkids. The principal walks the whole class.
I'm Pip, I'm new, and I asked why.
A girl whispered: just don't get happy.
But I was bored, so I kicked a ball.
I'm terrible at soccer. But it went in!
Up past the goalposts. Up past the school. Up past grandpa, who waved.
Even the goalie looked up. And up.
The whole class pointed. Somebody took a photo.
Then my mum grabbed the leash, and reeled me in like a kite.
See, this comet is tiny, so its gravity is almost nothing. Escape speed is slower than a stroll. One happy jump, and you're gone.
So now I wear a leash, a helmet, and a very serious face.
Last week a kid sneezed. We're still waiting.
Goals are banned. Please, hold the leash!
